description: We are from Cambodia and we want to help the farmers around the world to deal with the crop sustainability and measurement of the crop lands. Moreover, it gives them a chance to see the waterflow and landcover. IF the plant can not suit there, they tell which solution that make the land happens too. They also tell which plants and crops that can be plant in those land.
summary: This project is to help farmer measure and analyze their lands remotely from measuring areas to separate grid in order to know what piece that are suitable for land crops. It measures the pattern of weathers and waterflow to know which crops that can be sustained and marketing patterns too.
details:
This project is to help farmers on measuring the lands remotely from perimeters to areas. After it measuring, it separate to many grids which is very helpful because we know which pieces of land that can plant the crops.

Moreover, it can analyze the land whether it sweep or elevation as well as the weather pattern and waterflow nearby in the land. This is very helpful because it helps system to predict which crop that can plant and help farmer to make their own decision later. As the farmer wants to be more precise, they can test pH soil test manually which give them more precise and advise them what to solve the land to help the soil quality be improved accordingly. It also helps us know where the waterflow is and whether it fresh or salty in those nearby areas.

As for the tools and coding language, I used python language and react native expo which is a JavaScript framework. I used Claude AI to help me which coding and troubleshooting which I push into the Github repo and deploy in the Vercel.

My project started to be creative because we think deeply on the farmer in Cambodia. Most of them can not afford the products that measure the land and to analyze everything. So, we think about modern that most of them already had phone at least. So, why don't we create an app that help them while they can use the phone? This is where the ideas started to come up and we started to analyze that most land did not have clear shapes like rectangle. So, we instead make the point dots that let them estimate which land are they and rough estimate the land measurement remotely. After that, we want to separate grids because some pieces of land did not have the same quality which led them to land and weather analysis.

My long term goal of this project is that I want to publish publicly like in google play or app store which let them can use offline because some areas of farming in Southeast Asia did not have internet services within the areas that make it hard for them to use it. So why do not we make it offline and let them can download the specific villages or provinces that there land suppose to be. When they are there, they can measure the land and it will show accordingly by download the data before and I think I want to let them know when the data will update too. Overall, it will support farmers for long term by knowing where the water flow goes and which conditions that plant can grow.
